from common import *
import shutil
from backtest.scripts.maintenance import experiment_harness as native
from backtest.scripts.register.experiment_registry import load_registry
from backtest.scripts.maintenance.experiment_archive import ensure_experiment_metadata,scan_experiment_archives
state_path=BASE/'docs/harness-state.json'
def event(k,**kw):
    s=native.inspect_state(state_path,repo_root=ROOT,check_drift=False)
    return native.append_event(state_path,dict(type=k,**kw),expected_revision=s['revision'],repo_root=ROOT)
def main():
    save_source(__file__);s=read(state_path);assert s['status']=='stopping' and all(j['outcome']!='running' for j in s['jobs'].values())
    jobs=read(PROGRESS)['jobs'];assert len(jobs)==60;rows=load_registry(ROOT/'backtest/experiments/registry.jsonl');row=next(r for r in reversed(rows) if r['exp_id']==EID)
    for v in VARIANTS:
        proof=read(BASE/'docs'/f'predictions-{v}.json');assert len(proof['components'])==5
        check(proof['ensemble'])
        for c in proof['components']:check(c['model']);check(c['prediction'])
    accounts=[read(p) for p in (BASE/'metrics').glob('account-*.json') if p.name!='account-comparison.json']
    for a in accounts:check(a['source_report']);check(a['portable_daily']);check(a['prediction'])
    f=BASE/'docs/cleanup-dry-run.json'
    with f.open('w') as out:subprocess.run([sys.executable,'backtest/scripts/maintenance/cleanup_experiment_artifacts.py','--result-retention','platform','--only-result'],cwd=ROOT,check=True,stdout=out)
    dry=read(f);owned={str((ROOT/z).resolve()) for z in row['result_dirs']}
    kept={str(Path(z).resolve()) for z in dry['keep_result_dirs']};assert not dry['errors'] and owned<=kept
    assert not (owned & {str(Path(z).resolve()) for z in dry['delete_result_dirs']})
    assert all((BASE/'docs'/f'adapter-{p.stem}.json').exists() and read(BASE/'docs'/f'adapter-{p.stem}.json')['source_text']==p.read_text() for p in TMP.glob('*.py'))
    assert TMP.parent==Path('/private/tmp') and TMP.name.startswith('qlib-h5-top3.')
    items=[p for p in TMP.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
    manifest=[]
    for p in items:
        assert p.parent.name=='__pycache__' or (p.parent==TMP and (p.suffix=='.py' or (p.suffix=='.pkl' and (p.name.startswith(('valid-','formal-features-','weekly-h5-top3mix-infer-')) or p.name=='official-evaluation-inputs.pkl')))),p
        manifest.append({'name':str(p.relative_to(TMP)),'size':p.stat().st_size})
    write(BASE/'docs/temporary-cleanup.json',dict(directory=str(TMP),items=manifest))
    shutil.rmtree(TMP);assert not TMP.exists()
    cp=BASE/'docs/cleanup.json'
    write(cp,dict(temporary='cleaned',result='no_changes',mlruns='handled' if accounts else 'not_applicable',retained_result_dirs=sorted(row['result_dirs']),verified_components=60,ensembles=12,account_mlflow_sources=[a['source_report'] for a in accounts],temp_files_removed=len(items),preexisting_retention_warnings=len(dry['warnings']),unrelated_candidates=dry['delete_result_dirs']))
    event('cleanup',outcome='complete',audit=str(cp));s=event('close');assert s['status']=='closed'
    ensure_experiment_metadata(ROOT,row);assert not scan_experiment_archives(ROOT)['errors']
    print('Closed and verified',len(jobs),'prefix models and',len(accounts),'accounts.')
if __name__=='__main__':main()
